sessions.title: Quick algebraic manipulation
sessions.description: Choose useful algebraic forms before expanding or solving.
topics: Common factors and grouping
Difference of squares, perfect squares, and conjugate products
Simplifying rational expressions and checking denominators
Evaluating expressions from a known sum and product

sessions.title: Divisors and perfect powers
sessions.description: Use prime exponents to count divisors and recognize perfect powers.
topics: Prime factorization and exponent choices
Counting positive divisors and divisors with extra conditions
Recognizing square and cube divisors
Least multipliers and largest square divisors

sessions.title: Polynomial division, factors, and remainders
sessions.description: Use division, evaluations, and roots to simplify polynomial problems.
topics: Polynomial division and the quotient–remainder identity
Remainders from evaluating a polynomial
Roots and the factor theorem
Simplifying quotients while keeping denominator restrictions
Finding coefficients from roots or remainders

sessions.title: Counting integer solutions with restrictions
sessions.description: Turn restrictions into nonnegative variables or short, complete cases.
topics: Stars and bars for distributions of identical objects
Positive and nonnegative integer solutions
Lower bounds and substitutions
Weighted equations and parity restrictions
Short cases that count every solution exactly once

sessions.title: Completing the square and maximum/minimum
sessions.description: Find bounds from squares and explain when they are attained.
topics: Rewriting quadratics by completing the square
Maximum and minimum values and equality conditions
Maximum products with a fixed sum
Minimum sums of squares
Checking integer and interval restrictions

sessions.title: Tangency through radii and right triangles
sessions.description: Turn tangency into useful lengths by adding radii and joining centers.
topics: Perpendicular radii at tangency points
Distances between centers of tangent circles
Equal tangent segments
Right triangles formed by joining centers
Common tangents and circles in rectangles or right triangles

sessions.title: Finding polynomials
sessions.description: Reconstruct a polynomial or find a requested value from roots and evaluations.
topics: Building a polynomial from its roots, degree, and leading coefficient
Determining the remaining scale from a known value
Root sums, products, and coefficient comparison
Using known values and turning equal outputs into roots
Checking degree and uniqueness

sessions.title: Test and review
sessions.description: Apply December’s selected topics and review solution strategies.
topics: A test drawing on the month’s lectures
Review of approaches and common mistakes
